not increase milk supply and should not be used for this purpose.
Sustaining Maternal Milk Supply and Preservation 
of Successful Breastfeeding
Insufficient milk supply is rarely a problem for the well-fed, 
well-rested, and unstressed mother who stays in close contact 
with her baby. Sucking stimulates the flow of milk; thus feeding 
on demand should supply ample amounts of milk to the infant. 
Skin-to-skin care also can benefit the mother and baby by
